Asia Cup 2027 Venue and Dates Revealed

Bangladesh has proposed Mirpur, Sylhet, and Chattogram as potential venues for the Asia Cup 2027. The Asian Cricket Council has requested detailed information from the Bangladesh Cricket Board regarding these proposals. A final decision on the hosting rights is expected soon.
